execution.forward: ordinary dense FFN for every token
execution.dgrad: ordinary dense FFN input-gradient matmuls for every token, including inactive tokens
execution.wgrad: gathered active-row-only parameter-gradient matmuls for both FFN matrices; biases summed over active rows only
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference without masks or custom execution

validation.parameter_gradient_tolerance: rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12 in float64 against autograd on the gathered active-row reference

full_cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: realized scoring and gather/scatter estimates added separately
full_cost_accounting.evaluation: retained separately from training cost for every arm
full_cost_accounting.mps_visible_counters: diagnostics only; standard backward is undercounted on MPS

dense_fewer_quality_reference: results-program/level3-75/body6/dense-fewer_seed9406.json; identical body, online data stream, and newly generated held-out data; quality only, with cost recomputed from the CPU-calibrated dense step
primary_endpoint: ordinary dense held-out loss of low_max_abs_wgrad versus random_wgrad and dense-fewer at matched full training cost
exact_cost_rule: use the lower of the two final costs; keep the lower-cost arm at its final evaluation and linearly interpolate the other arm between its bracketing evaluations; also report both unadjusted final endpoints

decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs_wgrad beats random_wgrad but not dense-fewer; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs_wgrad beats random_wgrad and dense-fewer at exact matched cost
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: computing dense wgrad and merely masking its gradients
using sparse-deployment loss as the primary endpoint
using MPS-only totals as full costs
changing the custom backward, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level dense-fewer win
